name: pi-claude-bridge
description: Local Pi provider backed by persistent Claude Code sessions.

scripts.test: set -a && [ -f .env.test ] && . .env.test; set +a; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR=$(mktemp -d); export CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR; npm run test:unit && tests/int-smoke.sh && tests/int-multi-turn.sh && tests/int-cache.sh && node --import tsx --test tests/int-*.mjs && node tests/lib/check-deadlock-logs.mjs "$CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR"
